rules.title: Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing: use and sale of algorithmic devices
rules.requirement: It is unlawful to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device (software using nonpublic competitor data of two or more landlords to recommend rental rates or occupancy levels) to a landlord, and unlawful for a landlord to use such a device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property. Each month of violation and each property where it is used is a separate violation.
